svg.title: BLE 4 - A singer misses (part of) a song: repair

g.text: BLE 4 - A singer misses (part of) a song: repair
beacon seq changed → new state expected;
state frames → verified, applied: cur.hash, docs[3], pt
no local file with cur.hash → collect song frames (doc 3, dv)
repair timer: min(1.5 × pt, 3 s) legacy · 1 s extended [7.6]
song frames … some lost at the fire (distance, bodies, other radios)
[the carousel completes the group before the timer expires]
verify dh and SHA-256(file) == cur.hash → show lyrics
Normal case: the 3-pass burst covers typical loss;
compute missing byte ranges of the framed document
from the index bitmap (at most 32 ranges)
wait random 0-400 ms (0-2 s while the beacon shows BUSY) [10.8]
retry with backoff 300 ms × 2…, cap 2 s, ±25 % jitter [10.4]
write Transfer 0005 = 0x00 ‖ {doc 3, dv, hash = cur.hash, ranges} [9.7]
Data: 0x01 HEADER {dv, len, enc, dh, ranges}
Data: 0x02 DATA chunks (MTU − 6 bytes each), in order
bytes fill the same reassembly buffer as broadcast frames;
[dv gone (leader moved on) or bad range]
drop the group; the new state names the new song
[a request is queued (singer was out of contact) [10.7]]
write Request 0007 (sealed) on the same connection
While repairing the singer keeps listening:
frames that arrive by broadcast shrink the ranges still needed.
A singer with the song in a local library never starts
a song repair timer. A singer browsing the library (not on
the lyric view) lets the carousel finish instead [7.6].
